# objectNames the Armory sheet styles that ItemDatabase/app.py never sets.
#
# Every entry here is a rule with no widget behind it — dead CSS. The gate
# in tests/test_armory_theme.py
# (test_every_objectname_rule_has_a_widget_that_sets_it) fails on any id
# NOT listed here, because that is how three rules shipped unstyled in the
# 2026-09-18 tokenization wave (#TooltipStatusPill, #EquipItemIconLabel,
# #SimGradeLabel: the rule was written, the setObjectName was not).
#
# The four below are *older* than that wave — all four are equally dead in
# eb53cd6, the commit before it, and their rules were in the hand-written
# styles.qss too. They are listed rather than deleted because deleting a
# rule is a decision about a feature (was the widget renamed, or is the
# whole panel gone?), and this wave's brief was style-only. Whoever knows
# the answer should wire them up or delete them.
#
# Format: one objectName per line, no leading '#', with the reason above.

ChainNode
ChainSideLabel
ExpandableMaterialHeader
SkillRow
